workItem.objective: Make every custom public JSON loaded-artifact boundary use an owned exact parse of its digest-bound raw bytes, rejecting parsed-value substitution and mutation after validation.
deliverables: One internal shared strict UTF-8 JSON loaded-artifact helper that verifies raw bytes against the ArtifactRef digest, parses those exact bytes, rejects any supplied value not deeply equal to the parse, and returns an owned immutable copy
ContractGeneration runtime using only the owned parsed state, architecture, project overview, and optional current baseline values after validation
WorkDependencyAnalysis runtime using only owned parsed JSON inputs while preserving the separate binary WASM validation path
WorkDependency snapshot construction using owned parsed inputs and owned parsed resolver results before any selector, version, or digest logic
Negative regression coverage for digest-valid bytes paired with a different schema-valid parsed value at all three public boundaries
Mutation-isolation coverage proving caller changes after validation cannot alter fingerprints, snapshots, proposals, or candidate output
Focused tests and one complete canonical verifier run
verificationPlan: Inventory every custom validateLoaded boundary in the declared source scope and confirm why generic artifact-runtime loading is already safe.

Decode JSON with fatal UTF-8 semantics; reject malformed bytes, trailing invalid data, non-JSON values where an object contract is required downstream, and a supplied parsed value that is not deeply equal to JSON.parse of the exact bytes.
Return and use a newly owned immutable parsed value rather than continuing with the caller-owned loaded.value reference.
Do not apply JSON parsing to the OPA application/wasm artifact; keep its raw binary digest and exact-ref checks separate.
Preserve each module's existing public error class and error code by mapping helper failures at the boundary.

Add one digest-valid/value-substituted negative fixture for ContractGeneration runtime, WorkDependency runtime, and WorkDependency snapshot construction; each must fail before generator, proposer, reviewer, OPA, or resolver-dependent progression.
Add mutation-isolation coverage with a delayed checkpoint or resolver boundary where practical, proving a caller cannot change validated semantics during an await.
Run node --test --test-concurrency=1 over the three scoped test files.
Run npm.cmd run verify once from the isolated worker checkout and record exact counts and duration.
Parent will review, integrate with exact path/digest guards, rerun focused tests and npm.cmd run verify, then own release:check.

assignment.assignmentRationale: The work is a narrow integrity correction spanning three related public runtime boundaries and their focused tests. A single specialist owns implementation; the parent remains independent reviewer and integrator.

diagnosis.unaffectedBoundary: artifact-runtime.loadArtifactContent parses the verified bytes itself
diagnosis.securityProperty: Runtime semantics must be derived only from the exact raw bytes named by the ArtifactRef digest.

forbidden: change public schemas, module definitions, routing, adapters, gates, traceability vocabulary, or release catalogs
treat canonical JSON equivalence as proof that loaded.value is the exact parse when deep parse equality is required
continue using a caller-owned loaded.value after validation
parse or canonicalize application/wasm bytes as JSON
weaken digest, ArtifactRef, checkpoint, or semantic validation
modify dogfood replay generations or generated canonical artifacts
